Updated the Treasury Bulletin agency outlays skill and memory.

Generalizable lesson saved:
- For Treasury Bulletin agency outlay questions, YoY average growth should use arithmetic mean of adjacent fiscal-year percent changes.
- If the prompt has conflicting rounding instructions, field-specific rounding wins over the general instruction. In this case, YoY percent should be rounded to hundredths even though the prompt later says all numbers to thousandths.
